structured.approach: I followed the requirement-steps REQ-02 procedure. First I read the two contracted inputs (feat.prebacklog, feat.intake), the org routing map and the feature-level routing override. I classified the entry as a whole and then each of the seven change requests (CR-1 to CR-7), applying the workbook rule that each category has a Technical sub-category and that purely technical work is marked Technical Only. The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not in context, so for the duplicate check I searched hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ for this item's function names and its overdue, vendor and risk terms. The open items I found are related but none is a duplicate, so they are linked rather than merged. Repositories and routing come from the intake and the routing maps. Gaps are listed as non-blocking open questions. I did not use the GitHub connector because the repository files held what I needed.

claims.text: The entry is classified as a business feature and is not Technical Only, because it gives AP managers a user-visible way to see which overdue invoices belong to vendors that usually pay late, linked to roadmap item R-AP-12.

CR-1 (optional paid_date feed column), CR-2 (delays_by_vendor), CR-4 (optional risk argument on build_explanation_request) and CR-7 (end-to-end proof) are Technical Only sub-items. CR-3 (vendor_risk), CR-5 (overdue_with_risk) and CR-6 (renderOverdueRisk) carry the business outcome.
Impacted repositories: ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal.

The org-level routing map lists only ap_aging -> Backend Coding Agent. The feature override routes ap_pipeline to Data Engineering, ap_forecast to Data Science, ap_aging to Backend, ap_portal to Frontend, and the end-to-end tests to the Testing Agent.
No duplicate was found, so nothing was merged. Of the requirement files, only ZD-48600.md mentions paid_date, delays_by_vendor, vendor_risk, overdue_with_risk, renderOverdueRisk or 'Risk level'.

The open items ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 use the same 'more than 30 days past due' rule in ap_aging, ZD-48455 changes the portal aging table, ZD-48470 changes the same vendor feed rejection in ap_pipeline, and PROV-ACME-2026-11 says to keep the build_explanation_request signature. They are linked as related items, not merged.
No regulatory source applies, and the decision-log check found no conflict with D-2026-031, D-2026-044 or D-2026-050.
This agent cannot create the ticket itself because the approved api:github connector allows GET calls only. The classification file is the ticket content.

open_questions: OQ-C1: Is there an approved category taxonomy for the Pre Backlog sheet? 'Business feature (customer-facing enhancement)' with a Technical sub-category per area is proposed here.
OQ-C2: The org-level routing map names only ap_aging. Should the FEAT-ZD-48600 routing override (all four repositories plus the Testing Agent) be promoted to the org-level map?

OQ-C3: PROV-ACME-2026-11 says to keep the build_explanation_request signature. Is the added optional risk argument (CR-4) acceptable? And in what order should the ZD-48470 currency feed change and the CR-1 paid_date feed change land?
OQ-C4: Who creates the new ticket from feat.classification? This agent has no write access to a ticketing system.
OQ-C5: Please confirm the Technical Only split: CR-1, CR-2, CR-4 and CR-7 are Technical Only, and the entry as a whole is not.
The Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were again not in context (OQ-2 from feat.prebacklog is still open). The duplicate check used only the requirements/ folder.
structured.summary: I wrote feat.classification for FEAT-ZD-48600. The entry is a business feature for AP managers, linked to R-AP-12, and as a whole it is not Technical Only. Four of the seven change requests are Technical Only (CR-1, CR-2, CR-4, CR-7) and three carry the business outcome (CR-3, CR-5, CR-6). Impacted repositories are ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal, routed to the Data Engineering, Data Science, Backend and Frontend agents, with the Testing Agent for the end-to-end flow. Nothing was merged because no duplicate was found; five related open items are linked. Two of them may affect delivery: PROV-ACME-2026-11 says to keep the build_explanation_request signature, which CR-4 changes, and ZD-48470 changes the same vendor feed as CR-1. Five non-blocking open questions are raised.
